title: Maneno ya Upole (Theme 4: Dira)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child asks, thanks and says sorry with the polite word and a polite form of the sentence (naomba, tafadhali, asante, samahani).
representations: a chart: tafadhali, naomba, asante, samahani, pole
steps: Ask: asking, thanking or saying sorry?
contexts: asking for salt at the table
bumping into someone in a queue

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child says "Samahani!" and acts out two more situations.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Chagua sentensi yenye upole." Kwa nini "Nipe maji!" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Tunapoomba kitu tunatumia "tafadhali" na "naomba", si amri.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Umemgonga mwenzako kwa bahati mbaya. Utasema "___."" Kwa nini "Asante" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: "Samahani" husemwa ukikosea. "Asante" husemwa ukipewa kitu. "Pole" husemwa kwa aliyeumia.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni sentensi ipi ina neno la upole?" Kwa nini "Nimekuja." si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Maneno ya upole ni kama tafadhali, samahani, asante, pole na naomba.
Upole ni maneno yote: Tafadhali, naomba unipe maji.
